title: fumaria schleicheri subsp. microcarpa
intro: Fumaria schleicheri subsp. microcarpa, commonly known as Small-celled Fumaria, is a subspecies of the Fumaria schleicheri plant, belonging to the Fumariaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat various gastrointestinal issues and its potential anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria schleicheri subsp. microcarpa include its purported anti-ulcerogenic and anti-spasmodic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
